Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly claimed the shared tournament was Wimbledon by misattributing Francesca Schiavone’s 2011 singles final to Wimbledon instead of the French Open. Sources (including the visible snippet) indicated Schiavone was runner-up at the 2011 French Open, while Olga Morozova was a finalist at both the 1974 French Open and Wimbledon. This misreading led to the wrong overlap and a premature, incorrect conclusion.
